rowlet.name: Rowlet
rowlet.pokedex_entry: Flies noiselessly on delicate wings. It has mastered the art of deftly launching dagger-sharp feathers from those same wings.

dartrix.name: Dartrix
dartrix.pokedex_entry: Regularly basks in sunlight to gather power—presumably due to the frigid climate. Nonetheless, the edges of the blade quills set into its wings are keen as ever.

decidueye-shoten.name: Decidueye
decidueye-shoten.pokedex_entry: After living in a war torn country, it adapted and turned aggressive. Living in solitude, it learned to craft more powerful weapons and manipulate the foliage around them. Now armed with a bamboo bow and razor sharp petals, it soars in the sky shooting down anyone who stands in its path.

vulpix.name: Vulpix
vulpix.pokedex_entry: In its belly burns a fire, which Vulpix spits out in the form of fireballs. When young, this Pokémon has but one white tail. As the Pokémon matures, this single tail splits into six.

ninetales.name: Ninetales
ninetales.pokedex_entry: The coat of gleaming golden fur is quite magnificent. This species is said to store sacred power in its nine long tails and to live for a millennium.

kitsunova.name: Kitsunova
kitsunova.pokedex_entry: Myths from Hisui tell of an ashen fox that appears on full moons. Scientists in Shoten believe that fox was actually Kitsunova.

clauncher.name: Clauncher
clauncher.pokedex_entry: By detonating gas that accumulates in its right claw, this Pokémon launches water like a bullet. This is how Clauncher defeats its enemies.

clawitzer.name: Clawitzer
clawitzer.pokedex_entry: Clawitzer’s right arm is a cannon that launches projectiles made of seawater. Shots from a Clawitzer’s cannon arm can sink a tanker.

clawvurin.name: Clawvurin
clawvurin.pokedex_entry: After evolving it grows a second arm cannon powered by electricity. It releases periodic pulses to ward off other aquatic Pokémon, and a single shock can knock out a Wailord.

bulbasaur.name: Bulbasaur
bulbasaur.pokedex_entry: While it is young, it uses the nutrients that are stored in the seed on its back in order to grow.

ivysaur.name: Ivysaur
ivysaur.pokedex_entry: Exposure to sunlight adds to its strength. Sunlight also makes the bud on its back grow larger.

venusaur.name: Venusaur
venusaur.pokedex_entry: A bewitching aroma wafts from its flower. The fragrance becalms those engaged in a battle.

charmander.name: Charmander
charmander.pokedex_entry: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

charmeleon.name: Charmeleon
charmeleon.pokedex_entry: If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.

charizard.name: Charizard
charizard.pokedex_entry: Its wings can carry this Pokémon close to an altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very high temperatures.

squirtle.name: Squirtle
squirtle.pokedex_entry: When it feels threatened, it draws its limbs inside its shell and sprays water from its mouth.

wartortle.name: Wartortle
wartortle.pokedex_entry: It cleverly controls its furry ears and tail to maintain its balance while swimming.

blastoise.name: Blastoise
blastoise.pokedex_entry: The rocket cannons on its shell fire jets of water capable of punching holes through thick steel.

pidgey.name: Pidgey
pidgey.pokedex_entry: Very docile. If attacked, it will often kick up sand to protect itself rather than fight back.

pidgeotto.name: Pidgeotto
pidgeotto.pokedex_entry: This Pokémon is full of vitality. It constantly flies around its large territory in search of prey.

pidgeot.name: Pidgeot
pidgeot.pokedex_entry: This Pokémon flies at Mach 2 speed, seeking prey. Its large talons are feared as wicked weapons.

machop.name: Machop
machop.pokedex_entry: Though as small as a child, it has strength enough to easily throw a well-built adult. Striving to become ever stronger, Machop trains by carrying a Graveler on its shoulders.

machoke.name: Machoke
machoke.pokedex_entry: A sturdy creature boasting a robust physique and boundless stamina. Loves training above all else and voluntarily assists with tasks such as construction and clearing land.

machamp.name: Machamp
machamp.pokedex_entry: In close combat, its four arms afford it offensive and defensive supremacy. In but a blink, this valiant Pokémon can overwhelm its foes with more than 1,000 blows from its fists.

gastly.name: Gastly
gastly.pokedex_entry: Gaseous and completely impalpable. Also highly dangerous— inhaling part of its poisonous body will cause one to faint instantly.

haunter.name: Haunter
haunter.pokedex_entry: This frightful, malevolent spirit can glide through walls, appearing wherever it likes. According to rumor, victims of a Haunter's lick will wither to death day by day.

gengar.name: Gengar
gengar.pokedex_entry: Possesses potential victims' shadows in an effort to steal away the victims' lives. If your shadow begins to laugh, you must take hold of a protective charm posthaste!

magikarp.name: Magikarp
magikarp.pokedex_entry: A feeble, pitiful imbecile of a Pokémon that is nonetheless very hardy. Unperturbed by turbid water, it can be found living in all sorts of places.

gyarados.name: Gyarados
gyarados.pokedex_entry: I suspect this Pokémon to be the true identity of a dragon written of in ancient texts, which claimed that it razed an entire village with white-hot beams from its maw.

ditto.name: Ditto
ditto.pokedex_entry: When it encounters another Ditto, it will move faster than normal to duplicate that opponent exactly.

eevee.name: Eevee
eevee.pokedex_entry: Harbors the potential to evolve into manifold forms. Within Eevee lies the key to the mysteries of Pokémon evolution—I'm certain of it.

vaporeon.name: Vaporeon
vaporeon.pokedex_entry: Tests show that its cells closely resemble water molecules, which perhaps explains its ability to conceal its form while submerged. I believe the origins of mermaid folklore lie with this Pokémon.

jolteon.name: Jolteon
jolteon.pokedex_entry: Bristles its fur into sharp, needlelike points when enraged. One can hear electricity crackle in its breath when it exhales.

flareon.name: Flareon
flareon.pokedex_entry: Flames burn within a saclike organ inside this Pokémon. When Flareon inhales, these flames grow in intensity, reaching a mighty 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

snorlax.name: Snorlax
snorlax.pokedex_entry: This glutton appears in villages without warning and devours the entirety of their rice granaries—such occurrences have long been counted among the gravest of disasters.

dratini.name: Dratini
dratini.pokedex_entry: This Pokémon was long considered to be no more than a myth. The small lump on a Dratini’s forehead is actually a horn that’s still coming in.

dragonair.name: Dragonair
dragonair.pokedex_entry: This Pokémon gathers power in the orbs on its tail and controls the weather. When enshrouded by an aura, Dragonair has a mystical appearance.

dragonite.name: Dragonite
dragonite.pokedex_entry: This Pokémon is known as the Sea Incarnate. Figureheads that resemble Dragonite decorate the bows of many ships.

chikorita.name: Chikorita
chikorita.pokedex_entry: In battle, Chikorita waves its leaf around to keep the foe at bay. However, a sweet fragrance also wafts from the leaf, becalming the battling Pokémon and creating a cozy, friendly atmosphere all around.

bayleef.name: Bayleef
bayleef.pokedex_entry: Bayleef’s neck is ringed by curled-up leaves. Inside each tubular leaf is a small shoot of a tree. The fragrance of this shoot makes people peppy.

meganium.name: Meganium
meganium.pokedex_entry: The fragrance of Meganium’s flower soothes and calms emotions. In battle, this Pokémon gives off more of its becalming scent to blunt the foe’s fighting spirit.

cyndaquil.name: Cyndaquil
cyndaquil.pokedex_entry: Hails from the Johto region. Though usually curled into a ball due to its timid disposition, it harbors tremendous firepower.

quilava.name: Quilava
quilava.pokedex_entry: This creature's fur is most mysterious—it is wholly impervious to the burning touch of flame. Should Quilava turn its back to you, take heed! Such a posture indicates a forthcoming attack.

typhlosion-hisui.name: Hisuian Typhlosion
typhlosion-hisui.pokedex_entry: Said to purify lost, forsaken souls with its flames and guide them to the afterlife. I believe its form has been influenced by the energy of the sacred mountain towering at Hisui's center.

totodile.name: Totodile
totodile.pokedex_entry: Despite the smallness of its body, Totodile’s jaws are very powerful. While the Pokémon may think it is just playfully nipping, its bite has enough power to cause serious injury.

croconaw.name: Croconaw
croconaw.pokedex_entry: Once Croconaw has clamped its jaws on its foe, it will absolutely not let go. Because the tips of its fangs are forked back like barbed fishhooks, they become impossible to remove when they have sunk in.

feraligatr.name: Feraligatr
feraligatr.pokedex_entry: Feraligatr intimidates its foes by opening its huge mouth. In battle, it will kick the ground hard with its thick and powerful hind legs to charge at the foe at an incredible speed.

sentret.name: Sentret
sentret.pokedex_entry: When Sentret sleeps, it does so while another stands guard. The sentry wakes the others at the first sign of danger. When this Pokémon becomes separated from its pack, it becomes incapable of sleep due to fear.

furret-shoten.name: Furret
furret-shoten.pokedex_entry: Furret has a very slim build. When under attack, it can slickly squirm through narrow spaces and get away. In spite of its short limbs, this Pokémon is very nimble and fleet.

pichu.name: Pichu
pichu.pokedex_entry: Pichu stores electricity in the sacs on its cheeks but discharges it inadvertently when agitated or excited. Being yet immature, the Pokémon's handling of electricity is rather inept.

pikachu.name: Pikachu
pikachu.pokedex_entry: Possesses cheek sacs in which it stores electricity. This clever forest-dweller roasts tough berries with an electric shock before consuming them.

raichu.name: Raichu
raichu.pokedex_entry: It can discharge bursts of electricity exceeding 100,000 volts— a single strike with that amount of power would incapacitate one of the Copperajah of my homeland.

cleffa.name: Cleffa
cleffa.pokedex_entry: In silhouette, they resemble twinkling starlight. When shooting stars rain from the night sky, Cleffa gather in numbers and dance as though they are indeed incarnations of the stars.

clefairy.name: Clefairy
clefairy.pokedex_entry: It can be found in quiet mountain areas on a full moon's night. Its dancing and its tiny, faintly glowing wings confer upon it a lovely fairylike quality.

clefable.name: Clefable
clefable.pokedex_entry: Legend says that on clear, quiet nights, it listens for the voices of its kin living on the moon. I, too, often think of my homeland, so far away.

espeon.name: Espeon
espeon.pokedex_entry: Wields an arcane power with which it can predict the weather and even people's thoughts. When bathed in sunshine, the scarlet orb on its brow glows and builds energy.

umbreon.name: Umbreon
umbreon.pokedex_entry: It is most active in the wee hours of the night, when moonlight bathes the land. Its large eyes can pierce the darkness and perceive prey with absolute clarity.

onix.name: Onix
onix.pokedex_entry: This chain of immense stones resembles a giant serpent. Tremors shake the earth above as it burrows deep beneath the ground, feeding on boulders as it goes.

steelix.name: Steelix
steelix.pokedex_entry: This Pokémon evolved through use of a strange item. Its body is coated with steel powder and notably hard—not even diamond can leave so much as a scratch.

scyther.name: Scyther
scyther.pokedex_entry: The large, wickedly sharp scythes on its forearms are truly fearsome weapons. Prey's attempts to flee are unfailingly thwarted by this Pokémon's nimble motions.

scizor.name: Scizor
scizor.pokedex_entry: Evolved by way of a curious item. The shell covering its body has been shown to be stronger than forged steel.

larvitar.name: Larvitar
larvitar.pokedex_entry: It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large mountain, it will fall asleep so it can grow.

pupitar.name: Pupitar
pupitar.pokedex_entry: It will not stay still, even while it’s a pupa. It already has arms and legs under its solid shell.

tyranitar-shoten.name: Tyranitar
tyranitar-shoten.pokedex_entry: The quakes caused when it walks make even great mountains crumble and change the surrounding terrain.

treecko.name: Treecko
treecko.pokedex_entry: Treecko is cool, calm, and collected—it never panics under any situation. If a bigger foe were to glare at this Pokémon, it would glare right back without conceding an inch of ground.

grovyle.name: Grovyle
grovyle.pokedex_entry: This Pokémon adeptly flies from branch to branch in trees. In a forest, no Pokémon can ever hope to catch a fleeing Grovyle however fast they may be.

sceptile.name: Sceptile
sceptile.pokedex_entry: Sceptile has seeds growing on its back. They are said to be bursting with nutrients that revitalize trees. This Pokémon raises the trees in a forest with loving care.

torchic.name: Torchic
torchic.pokedex_entry: Torchic has a place inside its body where it keeps its flame. Give it a hug—it will be glowing with warmth. This Pokémon is covered all over by a fluffy coat of down.

combusken.name: Combusken
combusken.pokedex_entry: Combusken battles with the intensely hot flames it spews from its beak and with outstandingly destructive kicks. This Pokémon’s cry is very loud and distracting.

blaziken.name: Blaziken
blaziken.pokedex_entry: Blaziken has incredibly strong legs—it can easily clear a 30-story building in one leap. This Pokémon’s blazing punches leave its foes scorched and blackened.

mudkip.name: Mudkip
mudkip.pokedex_entry: In water, Mudkip breathes using the gills on its cheeks. If it is faced with a tight situation in battle, this Pokémon will unleash its amazing power—it can crush rocks bigger than itself.

marshtomp.name: Marshtomp
marshtomp.pokedex_entry: Marshtomp is much faster at traveling through mud than it is at swimming. This Pokémon’s hindquarters exhibit obvious development, giving it the ability to walk on just its hind legs.

swampert.name: Swampert
swampert.pokedex_entry: Swampert predicts storms by sensing subtle differences in the sounds of waves and tidal winds with its fins. If a storm is approaching, it piles up boulders to protect itself.

wingull.name: Wingull
wingull.pokedex_entry: It soars on updrafts without flapping its wings. It makes a nest on sheer cliffs at the sea’s edge.

pelipper.name: Pelipper
pelipper.pokedex_entry: Skimming the water’s surface, it dips its large bill in the sea, scoops up food and water, and carries it.

nincada.name: Nincada
nincada.pokedex_entry: It can sometimes live underground for more than 10 years. It absorbs nutrients from the roots of trees.

ninjask-shoten.name: Ninjask
ninjask-shoten.pokedex_entry: This Pokémon is so quick, it is said to be able to avoid any attack. It loves to feed on tree sap.

shedinja-shoten.name: Shedinja
shedinja-shoten.pokedex_entry: A strange Pokémon—it flies without moving its wings, has a hollow shell for a body, and does not breathe.

aron.name: Aron
aron.pokedex_entry: When Aron evolves, its steel armor peels off. In ancient times, people would collect Aron’s shed armor and make good use of it in their daily lives.

lairon.name: Lairon
lairon.pokedex_entry: During territorial disputes, Lairon fight by slamming into each other. Close inspection of their steel armor reveals scratches and dents.

aggron.name: Aggron
aggron.pokedex_entry: Long ago, there was a king who wore a helmet meant to resemble the head of an Aggron. He was trying to channel the Pokémon’s strength.

feebas.name: Feebas
feebas.pokedex_entry: It is a shabby and ugly Pokémon. However, it is very hardy and can survive on little water.

milotic.name: Milotic
milotic.pokedex_entry: It’s said that a glimpse of a Milotic and its beauty will calm any hostile emotions you’re feeling.

absol.name: Absol
absol.pokedex_entry: Because of this Pokémon’s ability to detect danger, people mistook Absol as a bringer of doom.

beldum.name: Beldum
beldum.pokedex_entry: The cells in this Pokémon’s body are composed of magnetic material. Instead of blood, magnetic forces flow through Beldum’s body.

metang.name: Metang
metang.pokedex_entry: Using magnetic forces to stay aloft, this Pokémon flies at high speeds, weaving through harsh mountain terrain in pursuit of prey.

metagross.name: Metagross
metagross.pokedex_entry: Metagross is the result of the fusion of two Metang. This Pokémon defeats its opponents through use of its supercomputer-level brain.

turtwig.name: Turtwig
turtwig.pokedex_entry: This Pokémon becomes more energetic the more sunlight there is. The part resembling a shell is similar to silt and is slightly damp and warm to the touch.

grotle.name: Grotle
grotle.pokedex_entry: Appears where there is clean spring water. The fruit that grows on the shrubs on its shell is sweet, nutritious, and truly delicious.

torterra.name: Torterra
torterra.pokedex_entry: This remarkable, large-bodied Pokémon would serve beautifully as borrowed scenery for a garden, and its strength is peerless. Torterra roams the wilderness in search of clean water.

chimchar.name: Chimchar
chimchar.pokedex_entry: Full of vigor and always in high spirits. It was once known by the name ”Lantern-Tail” and feared as some kind of apparition.

monferno.name: Monferno
monferno.pokedex_entry: The deeper the blue on its face, the more powerful it will grow to become. It leaps about every which way and lands powerful blows against its opponents with the flame on its tail.

infernape.name: Infernape
infernape.pokedex_entry: A tall, hardy Pokémon with a dazzling appearance. It shrouds itself in flame and battles as if engaged in dance—truly a sight to behold.

piplup.name: Piplup
piplup.pokedex_entry: Prefers cold climes and appears along coasts. It's an adorable little thing—as cute as any child—but it's also prideful, unwilling to accept handouts from people.

prinplup.name: Prinplup
prinplup.pokedex_entry: It swims gracefully through the frigid sea and sings with a voice like the roaring tide. It has powerful, sturdy wings and dignity to match.

empoleon.name: Empoleon
empoleon.pokedex_entry: Since ancient times, it has been revered by the people of Hisui, who call it the Master of the Waves. Its wings are a match for even master-crafted blades.

starly.name: Starly
starly.pokedex_entry: They live in the fields and mountains, gathering in large flocks. Their cries are quite obnoxious. Though small, their wings are strong—a strike from them leaves pain that persists for a week.

staravia.name: Staravia
staravia.pokedex_entry: They form remarkably large flocks and are constantly fighting amongst themselves. I suspect that those with magnificent plumes on their heads are the strong ones.

staraptor.name: Staraptor
staraptor.pokedex_entry: It has left the flock, having gained strength enough to survive on its own. The astounding force with which Staraptor flies through the air allows it to carry away large, burly targets.

shinx.name: Shinx
shinx.pokedex_entry: Shakes its body to generate electricity. Its stature belies its aggression—one must be patient to tame this Pokémon.

luxio.name: Luxio
luxio.pokedex_entry: Proudly uses its electrified claws as weapons. It seems to be a gracious Pokémon, evenly sharing the spoils of the hunt with others of its kind.

luxray.name: Luxray
luxray.pokedex_entry: They form packs, each having one male as leader. Legends say that when Luxray's two eyes shimmer with gold, the Pokémon can see through anything.

buneary.name: Buneary
buneary.pokedex_entry: My hypothesis as to why Buneary rolls up its ears is that its hearing is far too keen. I surmise that the Pokémon protects its hearing by limiting the sound that may enter its ears.

lopunny-shoten.name: Lopunny
lopunny-shoten.pokedex_entry: Its fur is warm and yet remarkably light. This Pokémon kicks as though it were a master of karate, driving back its opponents with ease.

spiritomb.name: Spiritomb
spiritomb.pokedex_entry: It lays curses by thinking wicked thoughts. Writings tell that this Pokémon was born out of the assembly of five score and eight malevolent spirits.

gible.name: Gible
gible.pokedex_entry: It nests in caves untouched by sunlight. Its sharp teeth may fall out when worn away or after an impact, but they regrow within a few days.

gabite.name: Gabite
gabite.pokedex_entry: Though Gabite are usually of a violent disposition, when I gave one a glass bead it had been eyeing covetously, it suddenly became quite docile.

garchomp.name: Garchomp
garchomp.pokedex_entry: Soars across the heavens at blinding speed—a magnificent sight! It has a feral disposition. Utmost caution is required if one meets a Garchomp out in the wilds.

riolu.name: Riolu
riolu.pokedex_entry: Though infantile in appearance, it has the mysterious ability to read the minds of humans. The pure of heart are met with Riolu's approval, while those of ill nature earn only its loathing.

lucario.name: Lucario
lucario.pokedex_entry: A most gallant-looking creature. It emits energy waves and controls them with precision, using them to sense even faraway beings. I have given the name ”aura” to this power.

rhyhorn.name: Rhyhorn
rhyhorn.pokedex_entry: Ludicrously strong—when it butts heads with a mountain, it is the mountain that shatters. But its short legs struggle with turns, and it is incapable of stopping unless it collides with something.

rhydon.name: Rhydon
rhydon.pokedex_entry: Rapidly rotates its horn to bore through bedrock. It swaggers around volcanic regions, protected from the lava's heat by its tough, armorlike hide.

rhyperior.name: Rhyperior
rhyperior.pokedex_entry: This Pokémon evolved through use of a curious item. Its rocklike hide is composed of a mysterious substance and can withstand a blow from a masterwork sword with nary a scratch.

leafeon.name: Leafeon
leafeon.pokedex_entry: Cells similar to those of plants have been found in its fur. Its hard tail can fell a large tree with one stroke, and the tail's sharpness exceeds even that of a sword crafted by a master.

glaceon.name: Glaceon
glaceon.pokedex_entry: Glaceon is able to lower its body temperature very quickly. It freezes the atmosphere, creating diamond dust that glitters like gems while it flutters and dances around.

ralts.name: Ralts
ralts.pokedex_entry: Tends to prefer people with a chipper disposition to those who are gloomy, but it has shown no discrimination with regard to age or gender. Needs more research.

kirlia.name: Kirlia
kirlia.pokedex_entry: It resembles a maiden in appearance, but it wields strange powers to project visions of paradise. I suspect the crimson ornaments on its head are the key to its abilities.

gardevoir.name: Gardevoir
gardevoir.pokedex_entry: It will dedicate itself to defending a master it has come to adore. Its pure white dress, reminiscent of those worn by ladies of nobility, is the dress of one who is willing to risk their life.

gallade.name: Gallade
gallade.pokedex_entry: The blades extending from its elbows are sharper than the finest swords. Its swordsmanship, albeit self-taught, is astonishingly impressive.

snorunt.name: Snorunt
snorunt.pokedex_entry: Arrives alongside the first snow. It's thought that homes Snorunt visit will prosper for many generations. By tradition, one might offer a lump of ice made from pure water at one's front door.

glalie.name: Glalie
glalie.pokedex_entry: It covers its body with an armor of ice harder than steel. Uses its breath to freeze prey, which it then devours as if they were frozen desserts.

froslass.name: Froslass
froslass.pokedex_entry: A Pokémon inhabited by the soul of a woman who died bearing a grudge in the snowy mountains. Legends of Froslass placing deathly curses on misbehaving men send shivers down my spine.

rotom-shoten.name: Rotom
rotom-shoten.pokedex_entry: This bizarre Pokémon appears to be a will-o'-the-wisp powered by electricity. Be wary, as Rotom is both smart and mischievous.

snivy.name: Snivy
snivy.pokedex_entry: They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.

servine.name: Servine
servine.pokedex_entry: When it gets dirty, its leaves can’t be used in photosynthesis, so it always keeps itself clean.

serperior.name: Serperior
serperior.pokedex_entry: It can stop its opponents’ movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.

tepig.name: Tepig
tepig.pokedex_entry: It loves to eat roasted berries, but sometimes it gets too excited and burns them to a crisp.

pignite.name: Pignite
pignite.pokedex_entry: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

emboar.name: Emboar
emboar.pokedex_entry: It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire.

oshawott.name: Oshawott
oshawott.pokedex_entry: This Pokémon from the Unova region uses the shell on its belly as a weapon to cut down its foes. Thus, I've conferred upon this shell the name ”scalchop”.

dewott.name: Dewott
dewott.pokedex_entry: Its exquisite double-scalchop technique is likely the result of daily training, and it can send even masters of the blade fleeing in defeat.

samurott-hisui.name: Hisuian Samurott
samurott-hisui.pokedex_entry: Hard of heart and deft of blade, this rare form of Samurott is a product of the Pokémon's evolution in the region of Hisui. Its turbulent blows crash into foes like ceaseless pounding waves.

venipede.name: Venipede
venipede.pokedex_entry: Its fangs are highly venomous. If this Pokémon finds prey it thinks it can eat, it leaps for them without any thought of how things might turn out.

whirlipede.name: Whirlipede
whirlipede.pokedex_entry: Whirlipede protects itself with a sturdy shell and poisonous spikes while it stores up the energy it’ll need for evolution.

scolipede.name: Scolipede
scolipede.pokedex_entry: Scolipede engage in fierce territorial battles with Centiskorch. At the end of one of these battles, the victor makes a meal of the loser.

sandile.name: Sandile
sandile.pokedex_entry: Sandile is small, but its legs and lower body are powerful. Pushing sand aside as it goes, Sandile moves through the desert as if it’s swimming.

krokorok.name: Krokorok
krokorok.pokedex_entry: Although this Pokémon has specialized eyes that allow it to see in the dark, Krokorok won’t move much at night—the desert gets cold after sunset.

krookodile.name: Krookodile
krookodile.pokedex_entry: While terribly aggressive, Krookodile also has the patience to stay hidden under sand for days, lying in wait for prey.

zorua-hisui.name: Hisuian Zorua
zorua-hisui.pokedex_entry: A once-departed soul, returned to life in Hisui. Derives power from resentment, which rises as energy atop its head and takes on the forms of foes. In this way, Zorua vents lingering malice.

zoroark-hisui.name: Hisuian Zoroark
zoroark-hisui.pokedex_entry: With its disheveled white fur, it looks like an embodiment of death. Heedless of its own safety, Zoroark attacks its nemeses with a bitter energy so intense, it lacerates Zoroark's own body.

litwick.name: Litwick
litwick.pokedex_entry: The younger the life this Pokémon absorbs, the brighter and eerier the flame on its head burns.

lampent.name: Lampent
lampent.pokedex_entry: It lurks in cities, pretending to be a lamp. Once it finds someone whose death is near, it will trail quietly after them.

chandelure.name: Chandelure
chandelure.pokedex_entry: In homes illuminated by Chandelure instead of lights, funerals were a constant occurrence— or so it’s said.

golett.name: Golett
golett.pokedex_entry: This Pokémon was created from clay. It received orders from its master many thousands of years ago, and it still follows those orders to this day.

golurk.name: Golurk
golurk.pokedex_entry: There’s a theory that inside Golurk is a perpetual motion machine that produces limitless energy, but this belief hasn’t been proven.

deino.name: Deino
deino.pokedex_entry: Because it can’t see, this Pokémon is constantly biting at everything it touches, trying to keep track of its surroundings.

zweilous.name: Zweilous
zweilous.pokedex_entry: Their two heads will fight each other over a single piece of food. Zweilous are covered in scars even without battling others.

hydreigon.name: Hydreigon
hydreigon.pokedex_entry: The three heads take turns sinking their teeth into the opponent. Their attacks won’t slow until their target goes down.

chespin.name: Chespin
chespin.pokedex_entry: Such a thick shell of wood covers its head and back that even a direct hit from a truck wouldn’t faze it.

quilladin.name: Quilladin
quilladin.pokedex_entry: They strengthen their lower bodies by running into one another. They are very kind and won’t start fights.

chesnaught.name: Chesnaught
chesnaught.pokedex_entry: When it takes a defensive posture with its fists guarding its face, it could withstand a bomb blast.

fennekin.name: Fennekin
fennekin.pokedex_entry: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.

braixen.name: Braixen
braixen.pokedex_entry: When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.

delphox.name: Delphox
delphox.pokedex_entry: Using psychic power, it generates a fiery vortex of 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit, incinerating foes swept into this whirl of flame.

froakie.name: Froakie
froakie.pokedex_entry: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

frogadier.name: Frogadier
frogadier.pokedex_entry: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute’s time.

greninja.name: Greninja
greninja.pokedex_entry: It appears and vanishes with a ninja’s grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars of sharpest water.

bunnelby.name: Bunnelby
bunnelby.pokedex_entry: It’s very sensitive to danger. The sound of Corviknight’s flapping will have Bunnelby digging a hole to hide underground in moments.

diggersby.name: Diggersby
diggersby.pokedex_entry: The fur on its belly retains heat exceptionally well. People used to make heavy winter clothing from fur shed by this Pokémon.

fletchling.name: Fletchling
fletchling.pokedex_entry: When this Pokémon gets excited, its body temperature increases sharply. If you touch a Fletchling with bare hands, you might get burned.

fletchinder.name: Fletchinder
fletchinder.pokedex_entry: Fletchinder are exceedingly territorial and aggressive. These Pokémon fight among themselves over feeding grounds.

talonflame.name: Talonflame
talonflame.pokedex_entry: Talonflame dives toward prey at speeds of up to 310 mph and assaults them with powerful kicks, giving the prey no chance to escape.

floette-eternal.name: Floette
floette-eternal.pokedex_entry: It gives its own power to flowers, pouring its heart into caring for them. Floette never forgives anyone who messes up a flower bed.

flabebe.name: Flabebe
flabebe.pokedex_entry: Flabébé wears a crown made from pollen it’s collected from its flower. The crown has hidden healing properties.

floette.name: Floette
floette.pokedex_entry: It gives its own power to flowers, pouring its heart into caring for them. Floette never forgives anyone who messes up a flower bed.

florges.name: Florges
florges.pokedex_entry: Its life can span several hundred years. It’s said to devote its entire life to protecting gardens.

espurr.name: Espurr
espurr.pokedex_entry: There’s enough psychic power in Espurr to send a wrestler flying, but because this power can’t be controlled, Espurr finds it troublesome.

meowstic-female.name: Meowstic
meowstic-female.pokedex_entry: The defensive instinct of the males is strong. It’s when they’re protecting themselves or their partners that they unleash their full power.

meowstic-male.name: Meowstic
meowstic-male.pokedex_entry: The defensive instinct of the males is strong. It’s when they’re protecting themselves or their partners that they unleash their full power.

inkay.name: Inkay
inkay.pokedex_entry: By exposing foes to the blinking of its luminescent spots, Inkay demoralizes them, and then it seizes the chance to flee.

malamar.name: Malamar
malamar.pokedex_entry: It’s said that Malamar’s hypnotic powers played a role in certain history-changing events.

binacle.name: Binacle
binacle.pokedex_entry: If the two don’t work well together, both their offense and defense fall apart. Without good teamwork, they won’t survive.

barbaracle.name: Barbaracle
barbaracle.pokedex_entry: Having an eye on each palm allows it to keep watch in all directions. In a pinch, its limbs start to act on their own to ensure the enemy’s defeat.

skrelp.name: Skrelp
skrelp.pokedex_entry: Skrelp looks like a piece of rotten seaweed, so it can blend in with seaweed drifting on the ocean and avoid being detected by enemies.

dragalge.name: Dragalge
dragalge.pokedex_entry: Dragalge generates dragon energy by sticking the plume on its head out above the ocean’s surface and bathing it in sunlight.

sylveon.name: Sylveon
sylveon.pokedex_entry: It emits a soothing aura from its ribbon-shaped organs. It wraps these appendages around quarrelers to instantly restore calm to the situation.

goomy.name: Goomy
goomy.pokedex_entry: Goomy hides away in the shade of trees, where it's nice and humid. If the slime coating its body dries out, the Pokémon instantly becomes lethargic.

sliggoo-hisui.name: Hisuian Sliggoo
sliggoo-hisui.pokedex_entry: A creature given to melancholy. I suspect its metallic shell developed as a result of the mucus on its skin reacting with the iron in Hisui's water.

goodra-hisui.name: Hisuian Goodra
goodra-hisui.pokedex_entry: Able to freely control the hardness of its metallic shell. It loathes solitude and is extremely clingy—it will fume and run riot if those dearest to it ever leave its side.

noibat.name: Noibat
noibat.pokedex_entry: No wavelength of sound is beyond Noibat’s ability to produce. The ultrasonic waves it generates can overcome much larger Pokémon.

noivern.name: Noivern
noivern.pokedex_entry: Flying through the darkness, it weakens enemies with ultrasonic waves that could crush stone. Its fangs finish the fight.

litten.name: Litten
litten.pokedex_entry: Trying to pet Litten before it trusts you will result in a nasty scratch from its sharp claws. Be careful.

torracat.name: Torracat
torracat.pokedex_entry: When facing a powerful enemy, Torracat’s fighting spirit gets pumped up, and its fire bell blazes hotter.

incineroar.name: Incineroar
incineroar.pokedex_entry: Incineroar’s rough and aggressive behavior is its most notable trait, but the way it helps out small Pokémon shows that it has a kind side as well.

popplio.name: Popplio
popplio.pokedex_entry: If Popplio want to create big, powerful balloons, they must be persistent. It takes daily practice for these Pokémon to develop their skills.

brionne.name: Brionne
brionne.pokedex_entry: On nights when the sea is calm, Brionne dance with one another to the singing of the Primarina that’s leading them.

primarina.name: Primarina
primarina.pokedex_entry: For Primarina, every battle’s a stage. Its singing and the dancing of its balloons will mesmerize the audience.

pikipek.name: Pikipek
pikipek.pokedex_entry: It may look spindly, but its neck muscles are heavy-duty. It can peck at a tree 16 times per second!

trumbeak.name: Trumbeak
trumbeak.pokedex_entry: From its mouth, it fires the seeds of berries it has eaten. The scattered seeds give rise to new plants.

toucannon.name: Toucannon
toucannon.pokedex_entry: Known for forming harmonious couples, this Pokémon is brought to wedding ceremonies as a good luck charm.

rockruff.name: Rockruff
rockruff.pokedex_entry: This Pokémon intimidates opponents by striking the ground with the rocks on its neck. The moment an opponent flinches, Rockruff attacks.

lycanroc-midday.name: Lycanroc
lycanroc-midday.pokedex_entry: With swift movements, this Pokémon gradually backs its prey into a corner. Lycanroc’s fangs are always aimed toward opponents’ weak spots.

lycanroc-dusk.name: Lycanroc
lycanroc-dusk.pokedex_entry: With swift movements, this Pokémon gradually backs its prey into a corner. Lycanroc’s fangs are always aimed toward opponents’ weak spots.

lycanroc-midnight.name: Lycanroc
lycanroc-midnight.pokedex_entry: With swift movements, this Pokémon gradually backs its prey into a corner. Lycanroc’s fangs are always aimed toward opponents’ weak spots.

mareanie.name: Mareanie
mareanie.pokedex_entry: Unlike their Alolan counterparts, the Mareanie of the Galar region have not yet figured out that the branches of Corsola are delicious.

toxapex.name: Toxapex
toxapex.pokedex_entry: Within the poison sac in its body is a poison so toxic that Pokémon as large as Wailord will still be suffering three days after it first takes effect.

bounsweet.name: Bounsweet
bounsweet.pokedex_entry: When under attack, it secretes a sweet and delicious sweat. The scent only calls more enemies to it.

steenee.name: Steenee
steenee.pokedex_entry: Any Corvisquire that pecks at this Pokémon will be greeted with a smack from its sepals followed by a sharp kick.

tsareena.name: Tsareena
tsareena.pokedex_entry: A kick from the hardened tips of this Pokémon’s legs leaves a wound in the opponent’s body and soul that will never heal.

oranguru.name: Oranguru
oranguru.pokedex_entry: It knows the forest inside and out. If it comes across a wounded Pokémon, Oranguru will gather medicinal herbs to treat it.

wimpod.name: Wimpod
wimpod.pokedex_entry: Wimpod gather in swarms, constantly on the lookout for danger. They scatter the moment they detect an enemy’s presence.

golisopod.name: Golisopod
golisopod.pokedex_entry: They live in sunken ships or in holes in the seabed. When Golisopod and Grapploct battle, the loser becomes the winner’s meal.

mimikyu-disguised.name: Mimikyu
mimikyu-disguised.pokedex_entry: There was a scientist who peeked under Mimikyu’s old rag in the name of research. The scientist died of a mysterious disease.

jangmo-o.name: Jangmo-o
jangmo-o.pokedex_entry: Jangmo-o strikes its scales to communicate with others of its kind. Its scales are actually fur that’s become as hard as metal.

hakamo-o.name: Hakamo-o
hakamo-o.pokedex_entry: Before attacking its enemies, it clashes its scales together and roars. Its sharp claws shred the opposition.

kommo-o.name: Kommo-o
kommo-o.pokedex_entry: Certain ruins have paintings of ancient warriors wearing armor made of Kommo-o scales.

grookey.name: Grookey
grookey.pokedex_entry: It attacks with rapid beats of its stick. As it strikes with amazing speed, it gets more and more pumped.

thwackey.name: Thwackey
thwackey.pokedex_entry: When it’s drumming out rapid beats in battle, it gets so caught up in the rhythm that it won’t even notice that it’s already knocked out its opponent.

rillaboom.name: Rillaboom
rillaboom.pokedex_entry: The one with the best drumming techniques becomes the boss of the troop. It has a gentle disposition and values harmony among its group.

scorbunny.name: Scorbunny
scorbunny.pokedex_entry: It has special pads on the backs of its feet, and one on its nose. Once it’s raring to fight, these pads radiate tremendous heat.

raboot.name: Raboot
raboot.pokedex_entry: It kicks berries right off the branches of trees and then juggles them with its feet, practicing its footwork.

cinderace.name: Cinderace
cinderace.pokedex_entry: It’s skilled at both offense and defense, and it gets pumped up when cheered on. But if it starts showboating, it could put itself in a tough spot.

sobble.name: Sobble
sobble.pokedex_entry: When it gets wet, its skin changes color, and this Pokémon becomes invisible as if it were camouflaged.

drizzile.name: Drizzile
drizzile.pokedex_entry: Highly intelligent but also very lazy, it keeps enemies out of its territory by laying traps everywhere.

inteleon.name: Inteleon
inteleon.pokedex_entry: Its nictitating membranes let it pick out foes’ weak points so it can precisely blast them with water that shoots from its fingertips at Mach 3.

rookidee.name: Rookidee
rookidee.pokedex_entry: Jumping nimbly about, this small-bodied Pokémon takes advantage of even the slightest opportunity to disorient larger opponents.

corvisquire.name: Corvisquire
corvisquire.pokedex_entry: The lessons of many harsh battles have taught it how to accurately judge an opponent’s strength.

corviknight-shoten.name: Corviknight
corviknight-shoten.pokedex_entry: With their great intellect and flying skills, these Pokémon very successfully act as the Galar region’s airborne taxi service.

applin.name: Applin
applin.pokedex_entry: As soon as it’s born, it burrows into an apple. Not only does the apple serve as its food source, but the flavor of the fruit determines its evolution.

flapple.name: Flapple
flapple.pokedex_entry: It flies on wings of apple skin and spits a powerful acid. It can also change its shape into that of an apple.

appletun.name: Appletun
appletun.pokedex_entry: Its body is covered in sweet nectar, and the skin on its back is especially yummy. Children used to have it as a snack.

sinistea.name: Sinistea
sinistea.pokedex_entry: The teacup in which this Pokémon makes its home is a famous piece of antique tableware. Many forgeries are in circulation.

polteageist.name: Polteageist
polteageist.pokedex_entry: Leaving leftover black tea unattended is asking for this Pokémon to come along and pour itself into it, turning the tea into a new Polteageist.

hatenna.name: Hatenna
hatenna.pokedex_entry: If this Pokémon senses a strong emotion, it will run away as fast as it can. It prefers areas without people.

hattrem.name: Hattrem
hattrem.pokedex_entry: Using the braids on its head, it pummels foes to get them to quiet down. One blow from those braids would knock out a professional boxer.

hatterene.name: Hatterene
hatterene.pokedex_entry: If you’re too loud around it, you risk being torn apart by the claws on its tentacle. This Pokémon is also known as the Forest Witch.

impidimp.name: Impidimp
impidimp.pokedex_entry: It sneaks into people’s homes, stealing things and feasting on the negative energy of the frustrated occupants.

morgrem.name: Morgrem
morgrem.pokedex_entry: With sly cunning, it tries to lure people into the woods. Some believe it to have the power to make crops grow.

grimmsnarl.name: Grimmsnarl
grimmsnarl.pokedex_entry: Its hairs work like muscle fibers. When its hairs unfurl, they latch on to opponents, ensnaring them as tentacles would.

yamask-galar.name: Galarian Yamask
yamask-galar.pokedex_entry: The spirit of a person from a bygone age became this Pokémon. It rambles through ruins, searching for someone who knows its face.

runerigus.name: Runerigus
runerigus.pokedex_entry: Never touch its shadowlike body, or you’ll be shown the horrific memories behind the picture carved into it.

milcery.name: Milcery
milcery.pokedex_entry: They say that any patisserie visited by Milcery is guaranteed success and good fortune.

alcremie.name: Alcremie
alcremie.pokedex_entry: When Alcremie is content, the cream it secretes from its hands becomes sweeter and richer.

falinks-shoten.name: Falinks
falinks-shoten.pokedex_entry: It picked up a new troop coordination from festival bonding that lets it move in perfect sync. The skill serves both its festival performances and its self-defense.

dreepy.name: Dreepy
dreepy.pokedex_entry: If this weak Pokémon is by itself, a mere child could defeat it. But if Dreepy has friends to help it train, it can evolve and become much stronger.

drakloak.name: Drakloak
drakloak.pokedex_entry: Without a Dreepy to place on its head and care for, it gets so uneasy it’ll try to substitute any Pokémon it finds for the missing Dreepy.

dragapult.name: Dragapult
dragapult.pokedex_entry: Apparently the Dreepy inside Dragapult’s horns eagerly look forward to being launched out at Mach speeds.

basculin-red-striped.name: Basculin
basculin-red-striped.pokedex_entry: Though it differs from other Basculin in several respects, including demeanor—this one is gentle—I have categorized it as a regional form given the vast array of shared qualities.

basculin-blue-striped.name: Basculin
basculin-blue-striped.pokedex_entry: Though it differs from other Basculin in several respects, including demeanor—this one is gentle—I have categorized it as a regional form given the vast array of shared qualities.

basculin-white-striped.name: Basculin
basculin-white-striped.pokedex_entry: Though it differs from other Basculin in several respects, including demeanor—this one is gentle—I have categorized it as a regional form given the vast array of shared qualities.

basculegion-male.name: Basculegion
basculegion-male.pokedex_entry: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.

basculegion-female.name: Basculegion
basculegion-female.pokedex_entry: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.

sneasel-hisui.name: Hisuian Sneasel
sneasel-hisui.pokedex_entry: Its sturdy, curved claws are ideal for traversing precipitous cliffs. From the tips of these claws drips a venom that infiltrates the nerves of any prey caught in Sneasel's grasp.

sneasler.name: Sneasler
sneasler.pokedex_entry: Because of Sneasler's virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen highlands. Preferring solitude, this species does not form packs.

qwilfish-hisui.name: Hisuian Qwilfish
qwilfish-hisui.pokedex_entry: Fishers detest this troublesome Pokémon because it sprays poison from its spines, getting it everywhere. A different form of Qwilfish lives in other regions.

overqwil.name: Overqwil
overqwil.pokedex_entry: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname ”sea fiend.” It slurps up poison to nourish itself.

sprigatito.name: Sprigatito
sprigatito.pokedex_entry: The sweet scent its body gives off mesmerizes those around it. The scent grows stronger when this Pokémon is in the sun.

floragato.name: Floragato
floragato.pokedex_entry: The hardness of Floragato’s fur depends on the Pokémon’s mood. When Floragato is prepared to battle, its fur becomes pointed and needle sharp.

meowscarada.name: Meowscarada
meowscarada.pokedex_entry: With skillful misdirection, it rigs foes with pollen-packed flower bombs. Meowscarada sets off the bombs before its foes realize what’s going on.

fuecoco.name: Fuecoco
fuecoco.pokedex_entry: Its flame sac is small, so energy is always leaking out. This energy is released from the dent atop Fuecoco’s head and flickers to and fro.

crocalor.name: Crocalor
crocalor.pokedex_entry: The valve in Crocalor’s flame sac is closely connected to its vocal cords. This Pokémon utters a guttural cry as it spews flames every which way.

skeledirge.name: Skeledirge
skeledirge.pokedex_entry: Skeledirge’s gentle singing soothes the souls of all that hear it. It burns its enemies to a crisp with flames of over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit.

quaxly.name: Quaxly
quaxly.pokedex_entry: Its strong legs let it easily swim around in even fast-flowing rivers. It likes to keep things tidy and is prone to overthinking things.

quaxwell.name: Quaxwell
quaxwell.pokedex_entry: The hardworking Quaxwell observes people and Pokémon from various regions and incorporates their movements into its own dance routines.

quaquaval.name: Quaquaval
quaquaval.pokedex_entry: Dancing in ways that evoke far-away places, this Pokémon mesmerizes all that see it. Flourishes of its decorative water feathers slice into its foes.

pawmi.name: Pawmi
pawmi.pokedex_entry: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

pawmo.name: Pawmo
pawmo.pokedex_entry: Pawmo uses a unique fighting technique in which it uses its forepaws to strike foes and zap them with electricity from its paw pads simultaneously.

pawmot.name: Pawmot
pawmot.pokedex_entry: Pawmot’s fluffy fur acts as a battery. It can store the same amount of electricity as an electric car.

nacli.name: Nacli
nacli.pokedex_entry: The ground scrapes its body as it travels, causing it to leave salt behind. Salt is constantly being created and replenished inside Nacli’s body.

naclstack.name: Naclstack
naclstack.pokedex_entry: It compresses rock salt inside its body and shoots out hardened salt pellets with enough force to perforate an iron sheet.

garganacl.name: Garganacl
garganacl.pokedex_entry: Many Pokémon gather around Garganacl, hoping to lick at its mineral-rich salt.

charcadet.name: Charcadet
charcadet.pokedex_entry: Its firepower increases when it fights, reaching over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. It likes berries that are rich in fat.

armarouge-shoten.name: Armarouge
armarouge-shoten.pokedex_entry: This Pokémon clads itself in armor that has been fortified by psychic and fire energy, and it shoots blazing fireballs.

ceruledge-shoten.name: Ceruledge
ceruledge-shoten.pokedex_entry: An old set of armor steeped in grudges caused this Pokémon’s evolution. Ceruledge cuts its enemies to pieces without mercy.

capsakid.name: Capsakid
capsakid.pokedex_entry: Traditional Paldean dishes can be extremely spicy because they include the shed front teeth of Capsakid among their ingredients.

scovillain.name: Scovillain
scovillain.pokedex_entry: The green head has turned vicious due to the spicy chemicals stimulating its brain. Once it goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.

tinkatink.name: Tinkatink
tinkatink.pokedex_entry: This Pokémon pounds iron scraps together to make a hammer. It will remake the hammer again and again until it’s satisfied with the result.

tinkatuff.name: Tinkatuff
tinkatuff.pokedex_entry: These Pokémon make their homes in piles of scrap metal. They test the strength of each other’s hammers by smashing them together.

tinkaton.name: Tinkaton
tinkaton.pokedex_entry: The hammer tops 220 pounds, yet it gets swung around easily by Tinkaton as it steals whatever it pleases and carries its plunder back home.

glimmet.name: Glimmet
glimmet.pokedex_entry: Glimmet’s toxic mineral crystals look just like flower petals. This Pokémon scatters poisonous powder like pollen to protect itself.

glimmora.name: Glimmora
glimmora.pokedex_entry: Glimmora’s petals are made of crystallized poison energy. It has recently become evident that these petals resemble Tera Jewels.

mankey.name: Mankey
mankey.pokedex_entry: An agile Pokémon that lives in trees. It angers easily and will not hesitate to attack anything.

primeape.name: Primeape
primeape.pokedex_entry: It stops being angry only when nobody else is around. To view this moment is very difficult.

annihilape.name: Annihilape
annihilape.pokedex_entry: It imbues its fists with the power of the rage that it kept hidden in its heart. Opponents struck by these imbued fists will be shattered to their core.

pawniard.name: Pawniard
pawniard.pokedex_entry: A pack of these Pokémon forms to serve a Bisharp boss. Each Pawniard trains diligently, dreaming of one day taking the lead.

bisharp.name: Bisharp
bisharp.pokedex_entry: Violent conflicts erupt between Bisharp and Fraxure over places where sharpening stones can be found.

kingambit.name: Kingambit
kingambit.pokedex_entry: Though it commands a massive army in battle, it’s not skilled at devising complex strategies. It just uses brute strength to keep pushing.

gimmighoul.name: Gimmighoul
gimmighoul.pokedex_entry: It lives inside an old treasure chest. Sometimes it gets left in shop corners since no one realizes it’s actually a Pokémon.

gholdengo.name: Gholdengo
gholdengo.pokedex_entry: It has a sturdy body made up of stacked coins. Gholdengo overwhelms its enemies by firing coin after coin at them in quick succession.

poltchageist.name: Poltchageist
poltchageist.pokedex_entry: Poltchageist looks like a regional form of Sinistea, but it was recently discovered that the two Pokémon are entirely unrelated.

sinistcha.name: Sinistcha
sinistcha.pokedex_entry: It prefers cool, dark places, such as the back of a shelf or the space beneath a home's floorboards. It wanders in search of prey after sunset.

duraludon.name: Duraludon
duraludon.pokedex_entry: The special metal that composes its body is very light, so this Pokémon has considerable agility. It lives in caves because it dislikes the rain.

archaludon.name: Archaludon
archaludon.pokedex_entry: It digs holes on mountains, searching for food. It’s so durable that being caught in a cave-in won’t faze it.

dipplin.name: Dipplin
dipplin.pokedex_entry: The head sticking out belongs to the fore-wyrm, while the tail belongs to the core-wyrm. The two share one apple and help each other out.

hydrapple.name: Hydrapple
hydrapple.pokedex_entry: These capricious syrpents have banded together. On the rare occasion that their moods align, their true power is unleashed.

mewtwo.name: Mewtwo
mewtwo.pokedex_entry: Its DNA is almost the same as Mew’s. However, its size and disposition are vastly different.

lugia.name: Lugia
lugia.pokedex_entry: Lugia’s wings pack devastating power—a light fluttering of its wings can blow apart regular houses. As a result, this Pokémon chooses to live out of sight deep under the sea.

ho-oh.name: Ho-Oh
ho-oh.pokedex_entry: Ho-Oh’s feathers glow in seven colors depending on the angle at which they are struck by light. These feathers are said to bring happiness to the bearers. This Pokémon is said to live at the foot of a rainbow.

kyogre.name: Kyogre
kyogre.pokedex_entry: Kyogre is said to be the personification of the sea itself. Legends tell of its many clashes against Groudon, as each sought to gain the power of nature.

groudon.name: Groudon
groudon.pokedex_entry: Through Primal Reversion and with nature’s full power, it will take back its true form. It can cause magma to erupt and expand the landmass of the world.

rayquaza.name: Rayquaza
rayquaza.pokedex_entry: It flies forever through the ozone layer, consuming meteoroids for sustenance. The many meteoroids in its body provide the energy it needs to Mega Evolve.

dialga.name: Dialga
dialga.pokedex_entry: This Pokémon is revered as a deity in Hisuian legend. The birth of Dialga was what caused the vast river of time to begin flowing in our world.

dialga-origin.name: Dialga
dialga-origin.pokedex_entry: This Pokémon is revered as a deity in Hisuian legend. The birth of Dialga was what caused the vast river of time to begin flowing in our world.

palkia.name: Palkia
palkia.pokedex_entry: This Pokémon is feared as a deity in Hisuian legend. The birth of Palkia was what caused the walls of our world to disappear, creating a sky that spans for infinity.

palkia-origin.name: Palkia
palkia-origin.pokedex_entry: This Pokémon is feared as a deity in Hisuian legend. The birth of Palkia was what caused the walls of our world to disappear, creating a sky that spans for infinity.

giratina-altered.name: Giratina
giratina-altered.pokedex_entry: There is one Hisuian verse that tells of a powerful light creating a deep shadow. I imagine that this deep shadow is Giratina.

giratina-origin.name: Giratina
giratina-origin.pokedex_entry: There is one Hisuian verse that tells of a powerful light creating a deep shadow. I imagine that this deep shadow is Giratina.

girashido.name: Girashido
girashido.pokedex_entry: A close relative of Giratina. It spars with Giratina in the Distortion World, and unlike its roguish relative, it prefers honourable fights.

cresselia.name: Cresselia
cresselia.pokedex_entry: Cresselia is reminiscent of the crescent moon. It leaves a brilliant line of light in its wake as it flies across the night sky. I daresay it resembles the heavenly maiden who created the Milky Way.

darkrai.name: Darkrai
darkrai.pokedex_entry: On a moonless night, a strange incident occurred in which every one of a village's inhabitants suffered nightmares. The villagers attested that Darkrai appeared before them in these nightmares.

arceus.name: Arceus
arceus.pokedex_entry: It is the heavenly fount from which pours the light that shines across Hisui. Its luminance guides and protects all Pokémon. Hisuian mythology states that Arceus is the creator of all things.

reshiram.name: Reshiram
reshiram.pokedex_entry: According to myth, if people ignore truth and let themselves become consumed by greed, Reshiram will arrive to burn their kingdoms down.

zekrom.name: Zekrom
zekrom.pokedex_entry: Mythology tells us that if people lose the righteousness in their hearts, their kingdoms will be razed by Zekrom’s lightning.

kyurem.name: Kyurem
kyurem.pokedex_entry: It appears that this Pokémon uses its powers over ice to freeze its own body in order to stabilize its cellular structure.

xerneas.name: Xerneas
xerneas.pokedex_entry: When the horns on its head shine in seven colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

yveltal.name: Yveltal
yveltal.pokedex_entry: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

zygarde-50.name: Zygarde
zygarde-50.pokedex_entry: Some say it can change to an even more powerful form when battling those who threaten the ecosystem.

zygarde-100.name: Zygarde
zygarde-100.pokedex_entry: Some say it can change to an even more powerful form when battling those who threaten the ecosystem.

zeraora.name: Zeraora
zeraora.pokedex_entry: Electricity sparks from the pads on its limbs. Wherever Zeraora runs, lightning flashes and thunder echoes.

zacian.name: Zacian
zacian.pokedex_entry: This Pokémon has slumbered for many years. Some say it’s Zamazenta’s elder sister—others say the two Pokémon are rivals.

zacian-crowned.name: Zacian
zacian-crowned.pokedex_entry: This Pokémon has slumbered for many years. Some say it’s Zamazenta’s elder sister—others say the two Pokémon are rivals.

zamazenta.name: Zamazenta
zamazenta.pokedex_entry: This Pokémon slept for aeons while in the form of a statue. It was asleep for so long, people forgot that it ever existed.

zamazenta-crowned.name: Zamazenta
zamazenta-crowned.pokedex_entry: This Pokémon slept for aeons while in the form of a statue. It was asleep for so long, people forgot that it ever existed.

koraidon.name: Koraidon
koraidon.pokedex_entry: This Pokémon resembles Cyclizar, but it is far burlier and more ferocious. Nothing is known about its ecology or other features.

miraidon.name: Miraidon
miraidon.pokedex_entry: This seems to be the Iron Serpent mentioned in an old book. The Iron Serpent is said to have turned the land to ash with its lightning.
